headline: IRAN 🇮🇷 Minister 🗣️ Begs 🥺 For NEGOTIATION 🤝 After TRUMP 🍊 REJECTS 🚫 Hormuz 🍆 Deal
text:
IRANIAN 🇮🇷 foreign 🗣️ minister 🧔 Abbas 🕌 Araghchi 📱 says 🗣️ only a NEGOTIATED 🏛️ SOLUTION 🧩 can END 🛑 the CONFLICT ⚔️ between US 🇺🇸 and Iran 🇮🇷 after Trump 🍊 publicly REJECTED 🚫 their proposal 📜 to REOPEN 🚪 the Strait 🌊 of Hormuz 🛢️!! The thirsty 🥵 Tehran team 🇮🇷 is still WAITING ⏳ for an official 🛡️ rejection 📬 despite the ORANGE 🍊 daddy's 🐺 White 🏠 House 🏛️ comments 💬 and they keep insisting 🗣️ that only TALKS 🗣️ will get everyone 🫂 out of this messy 💦 situation 🌪️ that started back in February ❄️ when the waterway 🚢 got shut 🛑 tighter than a suspicious intern's 👀 office door 🚪.

Trump 🍊 told 🗣️ reporters 📰 at the White 🏠 House 🏛️ that Iran's 🕌 proposal 📜 was straight up NOT ❌ acceptable 🤝 and that Tehran 🇮🇷 wanted to make a deal 🤝 to open 🌊 the strait 🛢️ to commercial 🚢 shipping 📦 within seven 7️⃣ days 📅 because they're LOSING 🥊 so BADLY 😵!! In a Telegram 📱 post ✍️ Abbas 🕌 Araghchi acknowledged 🤝 Trump's 🍊 rejection 🚫 but said Iran 🇮🇷 would wait ⏳ for a definitive 🛡️ official 🛡️ US 🇺🇸 response 📬 while reminding everyone 🗣️ that the president 🍊 has dropped 🫳 contradictory 🤨 statements 📢 in the past 🕰️ like a confused intern 😵‍💫 who can't decide which intern 🧑‍💼 to rail 💦 next 🔄.

The conditions 🧾 to open 🌊 the strait 🛢️ were exactly the same as the memorandum 📜 of understanding 🤝 MOU that was signed ✍️ in June ☀️ between US 🇺🇸 and Iran 🇮🇷 during those UN 🏛️ General 🗣️ Assembly 🏟️ talks 🗣️ in New 🗽 York 🏙️ this past week 📆 where Iran 🕌 raised reopening 🚪 the strait 🌊 and ending hostilities 🛑 on the sidelines ⚽️!! The vital 🚨 waterway 🛢️ through which around a fifth 1️⃣/5️⃣ of the world's 🌍 gas ⛽️ and oil 🛢️ supply usually flows 🏃 has been effectively CLOSED 🔒 since the outbreak 🌋 of war ⚔️ in February ❄️ leaving global prices 💰 skyrocketing 🚀 and consumers 🛒 getting absolutely COOKED 🍳 by fuel costs ⛽️.

I'm REJECTING 🚫 their deal 🤝 Trump 🍊 said on Saturday 🗓️ adding that the US 🇺🇸 already had TOTAL 🛡️ control 🎮 of the strait 🌊 with massive 🏋️ amounts of oil 🛢️ passing through it anyway 🚢 causing those massive rises 📈 in global oil 🛢️ prices 💰 and steep fuel ⛽️ cost increases for regular folks 🧑‍🤝‍🧑!! Araghchi 📱 wrote ✍️ on Telegram that Trump 🍊 has made many GOOD 👍 statements 📢 as well as many contradictory 🤨 ones which unfortunately 😩 we hear frequently 🔁 while they sit there edging 🫦 the mediators 🤝 waiting ⏳ for them to convey the definitive 🛡️ views 👀 so Iran 🇮🇷 can finally make a decision ⚖️ based on real talk 🗣️ instead of mixed signals 📡 from the big orange 🍊 daddy 🐺.

Separately Iran's 🕌 president 🧔 Masoud 🕌 Pezeshkian who traveled ✈️ to New 🗽 York 🏙️ for the UN 🏛️ General 🗣️ Assembly 🏟️ told the BBC 📺 that distrust 😠 created by this war ⚔️ needs to be overcome 🏆 in order for talks 🗣️ to be successful 🏅!! He said the Iranians 🇮🇷 were open 👐 to talks 🗣️ on implementing the MOU 📜 in stages 🪜 in order to end the impasse 🪦 but that the US 🇺🇸 needs to show it does not intend to overthrow 🤴 our government 🏛️ while reminding everyone that Trump 🍊 basically TORE 🪓 UP 📜 the MOU when the US 🇺🇸 resumed its bombing 💣 campaign and if we don't abide 📜 by what we have written ✍️ down can we really resolve it by dialogue 🗣️ bro??

Pezeshkian 🕌 also got asked about Iran's 🕌 new Supreme 🧿 Leader 👑 Mojtaba 🕌 Khamenei who was injured 🩹 in the US 🇺🇸 strike 💥 which killed ☠️ his father 👨 in February ❄️ and has not been seen 👀 in public since with reports 📄 claiming serious injuries 🦵 to his legs 🦵 and face 😷!! He said he had met the supreme leader 👑 on two 2️⃣ occasions 🤝 telling CBS 📺 he had no specific ongoing health 🏥 issues or challenges and had been well enough 💪 to hold seven 7️⃣ hours 🕐 of talks 🗣️ which is basically marathon 🏃 edging 🫦 for a supreme daddy 🐺 recovering from getting absolutely RAILED 💥 by American munitions 🚀 while Oman 🇴🇲 keeps begging 🥺 everyone to continue open dialogue 🗣️ and cooperate 🤝 to safeguard navigation 🚢 in that strategic 🗺️ waterway 🛢️ before everything explodes 💥 again.
